title: $L^p$ approximation results for infinite dimensional Neural Networks
summary: Leveraging the neural architectures which we introduced in arXiv:2109.13512v4, we show a global universal approximation theorem in the topology of $L^p(μ)$, where $1\le p<\infty$ and $μ$ is a Radon probability measure on a suitable infinite dimensional topological space $\mathfrak X$. Namely, any function $f:\mathfrak X\to \mathbb R$ in $L^p(μ)$ can be approximated to any degree of accuracy by suitable infinite dimensional architectures.
